title: Technical Product Manager - Cloud Platform
description:
Technical Product Manager - Cloud Platform
BrickRed Systems
Beaverton, Oregon, United States (On-site)

We are seeking a Technical Product Manager (TPM) Cloud Platform to lead strategy, development, and execution for multi-cloud managed services. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable, cost-efficient cloud platforms that empower developers and business stakeholders.

Apply Now! Join us in shaping the future of cloud platform engineering!

Key Responsibilities:

* Define product vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for cloud platform services.
* Partner with Engineering, UX, and business teams to drive platform adoption and value delivery.
* Track performance, optimize product execution, and integrate industry best practices.
* Ensure seamless security, governance, and developer-friendly integrations.

Required Skills & Experience:

* 5+ years driving complex, scalable software/cloud platform products.
* Strong background in DevOps, cloud-native solutions, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Kubernetes, etc.)
* Hands-on experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure services.
* Proven ability to collaborate with engineering teams & stakeholders to deliver impactful products.
* Excellent communication, analytical skills, and data-driven decision-making.

Bonus: Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP) & experience with Managed Services/PaaS.
